valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing (NYSE), no ADR conversion. Anchor: FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance raised on Oct 21, 2026 to $8.57-$8.62 (midpoint $8.595, from $8.45-$8.60); nine-month adjusted EPS is $6.11, so the implied Q4 is about $2.46-$2.51. Adjusted EPS excludes amortization, fair-value investment losses, acquisition-related items (including Masimo deal costs and inventory step-up), impairments and discrete tax items. Management gave no FY2027 EPS figure; it said 4-5% core revenue growth excluding respiratory is the starting point for 2027, with formal guidance in January, so FY2027 EPS is my assumption. Share basis: 706.8M diluted weighted shares in Q3 2026 and 703.5M shares outstanding at the reference date. Interest expense rose to $135M in Q3 from $67M a year earlier, reflecting debt raised for the Masimo acquisition, which is a drag already in the adjusted EPS base.

bear.driver: Respiratory revenue fades further and core growth stays near the low end of the 4-5% starting point; Masimo interest and dilution absorb most operating leverage; the multiple de-rates as the stock loses its recovery narrative.
bear.assumption: FY2027 EPS $8.90 (+3.5% on the FY2026 midpoint) at 22x

base.driver: Core growth recovers to about 5% excluding respiratory, Q3 adjusted EPS growth of 11.5% moderates to about 9% through cost actions and the Masimo integration, and the stock keeps a premium to peers at about 26x.
base.assumption: FY2027 EPS $9.35 (+8.8% on the FY2026 midpoint) at 26x

bull.driver: Core growth accelerates above the starting range as diagnostics and bioprocess demand recover, the Masimo deal adds synergies earlier than planned, and the market pays a growth multiple for a clearer share-gain story.
bull.assumption: FY2027 EPS $9.70 (+12.9% on the FY2026 midpoint) at 29x

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $9.35 the $233.02 close implies 24.9x; on FY2026 guidance midpoint it implies 27.1x. The analyst-weighted target (the TipRanks 3-month average of $258 across 13 analysts, with 11 named calls here) implies 27.6x base EPS, or EPS of about $9.92 at 26x (about 6% above the base).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by about $9.35 (3.8 pp of the base return); a one-turn change in the bull and bear multiples moves targets by $9.70 and $8.90 respectively. A 1% change in FY2027 EPS moves the base target by about $2.43.
valuation.watch_metric: Core revenue growth excluding respiratory revenue, and whether Q4 2026 core growth of 4-5% (guided) and the 2027 starting point of 4-5% hold, with adjusted operating margin expansion and Masimo synergies visible in the adjusted EPS line.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results and FY2027 outlook, expected in late January 2027 per the company's statement that formal 2027 guidance will come in January.

analyst_notes: Eleven named analysts with dated calls since Oct 1, 2026 raised or reiterated targets after the Oct 21 Q3 beat: nine raises to $250-$275 and reiterations from UBS ($260) and others, so most named targets now sit above the $233.02 close and the base case of $243.10. The gap to the analyst view is about 6% of EPS at 26x, which is consistent with analysts assuming a faster 2027 earnings recovery, a re-rating toward the mid-to-high 20s, or both; the sample does not reveal which. Coverage is partial and the horizons are not documented in the sources, so no named target carries a weighted 12-month horizon here; the figures are an unweighted read. The MarketBeat consensus of $239.50 (Oct 22) and the Yahoo Finance aggregate of 21 analysts (mean $259.90) are shown for context only and are not included in the event rows.
